style: Simplified, chunky stylized fantasy game art with about 30 percent less detail than a typical painted fantasy asset: a few big readable shapes, thick dark-brown outlines, flat color masses with two-step cel shading and one soft highlight, very little texture. No filigree, no tiny rivets, no engraved patterns, no gem encrustations, no pedestals, stands or display bases, no ornate frames. Light deformation is welcome (exaggerate the one key part, simplify the rest); cute but not childish. Saturated but harmonious colors. Do not imitate any existing game, character, franchise or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, logos or symbols. Card illustrations for the half-dragon warrior heroine (the attached reference). Each card is a small dynamic scene that makes the card's name easy to remember: show her full figure or three-quarter figure performing the action, with her face drawn as in the reference (anime-style, amber dragon eyes, mischievous grin). Enemies are chunky moss-covered stone-and-bronze golems with teal rune eyes. Each card uses its own dominant background color so the cards look clearly different from each other.
